system.description: You can conduct a Ritual (p. 10) to conjure a familiar that you control with your Action or by skipping your Move. The familiar can be any Small Being with HD: 1. It uses your Cast Skill for Checks, and you can Cast Spells from the familiar as if it were originating from you. The familiar is banished when it drops to 0 HP or if you conduct this Ritual again to create another familiar.
